mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS_DETAIL(ORDERS_ID,PRODUCT_ID,AMOUNT,CREATED_AT,UPDATED_AT, product_price, product_name, product_description, product_image_url) VALUES (#{orderId},#{productId},#{amount},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{productPrice},#{productName},#{productDescription},#{productImage_url})
mapper.select: select id , orders_id , product_id, amount, created_at, updated_at, product_price, product_name, product_description, product_image_url from ORDERS_DETAIL where orders_id=#{orderId}
